description: UNDERSTANDING — Compare 2+ providers side by side: composite/band, per-facet leaders, an artifact-coverage matrix, and each provider's economics — audience, pricing basis, delivery, graded entry cost (USD/month) and marginal cost (USD per unit), with the plan and the quoted figure behind each number and the date it was read; `cheapest_entry` names the cheapest published way in. Priced B2 (cross-catalog synthesis) — $0.05 per call under pay-as-you-go; included in Understanding and Influence. See apis://prices.
